assumptions: CLI route `--metric mad` -> mad_rgb8 (lib.rs:288-301): RGB8 -> unrounded rgb2gray luma (0.2989/0.5870/0.1140, Inputs::from_rgb8) -> kernel::mad_score (kernel.rs:1104-1130), maps=None.

hi_index (kernel.rs:761-1010): luma transform k*x^(2.2/3) via 256-entry LUT (u8 path, kernel.rs:766-790) -> csf_apply per image = fft2 + ifft2_planned_mul(csf) (kernel.rs:153-175: real(ifft2(fftshift(fft2(x)).*csf))) -> diff -> ical_std blocky stats (kernel.rs:219-426, 16x16 tiles) -> err^2 + symmetric pad + separable box-16 lmse (kernel.rs:845-930) -> per-tile msk from log/threshold (kernel.rs:936-960) -> mp_hi = msk*lm.

lo_index (kernel.rs:962-1055): gabor_grids_cached (5 scales x 4 orientations, cached Arc -> build cost excluded, kernel.rs:649-675) -> ONE fft2 per image -> 20 x gabor_apply_mag per image = ifft2_planned_mul_mag_into (IFFT + conj-mul + magnitude, kernel.rs:677-710) -> ical_stat (std/skew/kurt tiles, kernel.rs:443-570) per result -> weighted tile accumulation -> expand to pixels.
ical_std/ical_stat: blocky 16x16/4x4 tile moments accumulated per px then completed per tile; per-px ~6-8 ops amortized.

FFT cost model: complex f32 FFT ~5*log2(N) flops/element per transform; csf_apply = 2 transforms + conj-mul; each gabor mag = 1 IFFT + conj-mul + |.|. Totals per image ~46 transforms across both indices.
lmse box16 is LITERAL 16-tap accumulate per output per pass (kernel.rs:880-925, for u in 0..B), not running-sum: 16 adds/px/pass counted.
hi norm = interior_norm*10 over (w-33)x(h-33) interior; lo norm over expanded map; JEI combine scalar (pow/exp x3).

stages.name: luminance k*x^(2.2/3) via 256-LUT
stages.notes: LUT index from f32? u8-derived path uses lum_lut[256] (pow memoized); f32 path does f64 pow per el - count LUT path (CLI is u8-derived luma).

stages.name: CSF-weighting FFT pair per image
stages.notes: fft2 + pointwise fftshift csf conj-mul + ifft2 -> real plane. Complex f32, ~5*log2(N) flops/el/transform.

stages.name: dst_l - ref_l + err^2
stages.notes: Two element planes (diff + e2); mul counted once per e2 el.

stages.name: blocky 16x16 tile moments (std2,std1,m1_1)
stages.notes: Per-px accumulation into 16x16 tile sums (diff^2, ref stats); per-tile f64 completion amortized to ~0.05 st/el. 3 tile planes output.

stages.name: box-16 horizontal on padded rows
stages.notes: Literal 16-tap sum per output (not running sum) -> tmp (h+16) x w plane.

stages.name: per-tile msk (log/thresholds) x lmse
stages.notes: msk computed once per 16px tile (2 logs + compares -> ~0.01-0.03/el amortized), broadcast multiply into 4x4-written mp_hi.

stages.name: fft2 of each image for the Gabor bank
stages.notes: One forward fft2 per image; the 20 scale/orientation filters share it.

stages.name: 20x ifft2 + conj-mul + magnitude per image
stages.notes: ifft2_planned_mul_mag_into: IFFT + fftshift(logGabor*spread) conj-mul + |c|. 5 scales x 4 orientations x 2 images; magnitude plane feeds ical_stat.

stages.name: blocky 4x4 tile moments x20 (std,skew,kurt)
stages.notes: std/skew/kurt tile moments per gabor result per image; tile planes at NT=ceil(W/4)*ceil(H/4) resolution.

stages.name: weighted tile accumulation -> mp_lo expand
stages.notes: mp += s*(|dstd|+2|dskw|+|dkurt|) per tile x 20 gabor pairs (ops folded per px: 20/16 px-el -> scaled); expand 4x4 fill.

stages.name: interior_norm x2 + JEI combine
stages.notes: RMS/mean over (w-33)x(h-33) interiors; JEI sig/pow combine is scalar.
